cando.en.a0.u01.greet: Bisa ngucapake halo, matur nuwun, tulung, njaluk ngapura, lan pamitan ing kahanan saben dina.
cando.en.a0.u02.sounds: Bisa ngrungokake lan niru bedane swara vokal lan konsonan dhasar ing basa Inggris.
cando.en.a0.u01.basics: Bisa nggunakake sawetara frasa pitulungan: salam, matur nuwun, lan njaluk wong liya supaya alon-alon.
cando.en.a0.u01.numbers: Bisa ngucapake lan ngerteni angka siji nganti sepuluh.
cando.en.a1.u01.greet: Bisa menehi salam marang wong liya, nanggepi salam, lan pamitan kanthi sopan.
cando.en.a1.u01.intro-self: Bisa nyebutake jenenge lan ngenalake awake dhewe kanthi ukara sing prasaja.
cando.en.a1.u02.langs: Bisa nyebutake basa apa wae sing dikuasai.
cando.en.a1.u02.origin: Bisa nyebutake asale saka negara ngendi lan takon marang wong liya babagan sing padha.
cando.en.a1.u03.family: Bisa nyebutake anggota kulawarga cedhak lan ngandhakake babagan dheweke kanthi prasaja.
cando.en.a1.u04.count: Bisa ngitung, nyebutake rega lan umur, lan ngerteni angka nalika krungu.
cando.en.a1.u05.clock: Bisa takon lan menehi katrangan wektu kanthi prasaja.
cando.en.a1.u05.dates: Bisa nyebutake dina, tanggal, lan kapan kedadeyan sawijining bab.
cando.en.a1.u06.likes: Bisa nyebutake panganan lan ombenan apa sing disenengi lan dikarepake.
cando.en.a1.u07.order: Bisa pesen panganan lan ombenan kanthi sopan lan njaluk tagihan.
cando.en.a1.u08.around-town: Bisa nyebutake apa wae sing ana ing kutha lan panggonane barang-barang.
cando.en.a1.u09.routine: Bisa njlentrehake pakaryan saben dinane lan sepira kerepe nindakake sawijining bab.
cando.en.a1.u10.jobs: Bisa nyebutake pakaryane lan takon marang wong liya babagan pakaryane.
cando.en.a1.u11.possessions: Bisa nyebutake apa sing diduweni lan takon apa sing diduweni wong liya.
cando.en.a1.u12.describe-things: Bisa nyebutake warna lan sandhangan sarta njlentrehake wujud barang-barang.
cando.en.a1.u13.ability: Bisa nyebutake apa sing bisa lan ora bisa ditindakake sarta nggawe panjaluk sing prasaja.
cando.en.a1.u14.now: Bisa njlentrehake apa sing kedadeyan ing saubenge ing wektu iki.
cando.en.a1.u15.weather: Bisa ngrembug babagan cuaca lan mangsa kanthi prasaja.
cando.en.a1.u16.transport: Bisa tuku karcis, ngetutake pituduh sing prasaja, lan nggunakake transportasi umum.
cando.en.a1.u17.prices: Bisa takon regane barang lan nangani tuku-tuku sing prasaja.
cando.en.a1.u18.describe-people: Bisa njlentrehake wujud lan sipate wong liya.
cando.en.a1.u19.hobbies: Bisa ngrembug babagan hobi lan kegiatan wektu luang sing disenengi.
cando.en.a1.u20.past: Bisa nyebutake ana ing ngendi lan apa sing ditindakake ing ukara past tense sing prasaja.
cando.en.a1.u21.tell-past: Bisa nyritakake crita cekak babagan minggu kepungkur nggunakake kriya past tense sing umum.
cando.en.a1.u22.plans: Bisa ngrembug babagan rencana lan ngajak wong liya nindakake samubarang bebarengan.
cando.en.a1.u23.feelings: Bisa nyebutake perasaane lan njlentrehake masalah kesehatan sing prasaja.
cando.en.a1.u24.home: Bisa njlentrehake omahe sarta kamar lan barang-barang sing ana ing njero.
cando.en.a1.u25.compare: Bisa mbandhingake wong, panggonan, lan barang ing ukara sing prasaja.
cando.en.a1.u26.connect: Bisa nggabungake gagasan prasaja kanthi 'and', 'but', lan 'because'.
cando.en.a1.u27.about-me: Bisa menehi pambuka lisan cekak: sapa dheweke, apa pakaryane, lan apa sing disenengi.
cando.en.a1.u28.show: Bisa nggabungake kabeh materi ing siji sesi review.
cando.en.a2.u01.interrupted: Bisa nyritakake apa sing lagi kedadeyan nalika ana kedadeyan liya sing dumadakan.
cando.en.a2.u01.ongoing: Bisa njlentrehake apa sing lagi ditindakake ing sawijining wektu tartamtu ing jaman kepungkur.
cando.en.a2.u02.habits: Bisa njlentrehake pakulinan lan kahanan kepungkur sing wis ora bener maneh.
cando.en.a2.u02.then-now: Bisa mbandhingake kepiye kahanan biyen karo kepiye saiki.
cando.en.a2.u03.experiences: Bisa takon lan ngrembug babagan pengalaman urip tanpa nyebutake kapan, sarta mbedakake 'been' lan 'gone'.
cando.en.a2.u04.duration: Bisa nyebutake sepira wis lawase sawijining bab bener, kanthi nganggo 'for' lan 'since'.
cando.en.a2.u04.progress: Bisa nyebutake apa sing wis ditindakake, isih kudu ditindakake, utawa lagi wae rampung.
cando.en.a2.u05.past-vs-perfect: Bisa milih antarane past simple utawa present perfect gumantung wektune wis rampung apa durung, sarta bisa nyritakake owah-owahan lan kepiye wiwitane.
cando.en.a2.u06.offers: Bisa nawakake pitulungan utawa nggawe janji cepet kanthi nganggo 'will' sanalika kuwi.
cando.en.a2.u06.predictions: Bisa nggawe prediksi prasaja kanthi nganggo 'will', kalebu ramalan cuaca cekak.
cando.en.a2.u07.arrangements: Bisa nyebutake rencana sing wis mesthi karo wektune, kanthi nganggo present continuous.
cando.en.a2.u07.plans: Bisa ngrembug rencana sing wis digawe, milih 'going to' tinimbang 'will'.
cando.en.a2.u08.conditions: Bisa nyebutake apa sing kedadeyan utawa bakal kedadeyan yen sawijining syarat kelakon, kanthi nganggo 'if' karo present utawa 'will'.
cando.en.a2.u08.timing: Bisa nggandhengake siji tumindak mangsa ngarep karo liyane kanthi 'when' utawa 'as soon as'.
cando.en.a2.u09.advice: Bisa menehi pituduh prasaja babagan masalah saben dina, kanthi nganggo 'should' lan 'shouldn't'.
cando.en.a2.u10.rules: Bisa njlentrehake aturane sawijining papan lan nyebutake apa sing diwajibake, diijinake, utawa dilarang, kanthi nganggo 'have to', 'must', lan 'mustn't'.
cando.en.a2.u11.requests: Bisa nggawe panjaluk sing sopan kanthi 'could', lan nawakake utawa njaluk apa sing dikarepake kanthi 'would'.
cando.en.a2.u12.possibility: Bisa nyebutake apa sing bisa uga kedadeyan utawa bener, tanpa ngaku yen kuwi mesthi.
cando.en.a2.u13.quantity-questions: Bisa takon regane sawijining barang utawa cacahe, kanthi nganggo 'how much' lan 'how many' kanthi bener.
cando.en.a2.u13.quantity-words: Bisa nganggo 'many', 'much', lan 'a lot of' kanthi bener karo kata benda sing bisa lan ora bisa diitung, sarta njaluk cacah prasaja nalika blanja.
cando.en.a2.u14.amounts: Bisa nyebutake nalika sawijining bab kakehan, durung cukup, utawa wis pas, sarta njaluk cacah sethithik kanthi nganggo 'a few' utawa 'a little'.
cando.en.a2.u15.equal: Bisa nyebutake apa rong barang padha utawa ora, kanthi nganggo 'as … as' lan 'not as … as'.
cando.en.a2.u15.manner: Bisa mbandhingake kepiye apik, cepet, utawa kerepe sawijining bab ditindakake, kanthi nganggo kata keterangan komparatif.
cando.en.a2.u16.feedback: Bisa njlentrehake kepiye sawijining bab ditindakake lan sepira apik utawa alane, kanthi nganggo kata keterangan cara lan tingkat.
cando.en.a2.u17.gerunds: Bisa ngrembug apa sing disenengi lan ora disenengi ing wektu luang, kanthi nganggo 'enjoy', 'like', 'love', 'hate', lan 'stop' sadurunge kriya -ing.
cando.en.a2.u18.goals: Bisa nyebutake apa sing dikarepake, dibutuhake, diarep-arep, utawa wis diputusake, kanthi nganggo kriya + to-infinitive.
cando.en.a2.u18.purpose: Bisa nyebutake kenapa nindakake sawijining bab, kanthi nganggo to + kriya kanggo tujuan.
cando.en.a2.u19.devices: Bisa njlentrehake kepiye nggunakake piranti saben dina, kanthi nganggo phrasal verb kaya 'turn on/off' lan 'get up', sarta pasangan kriya + preposisi kaya 'listen to', 'wait for', lan 'look for'.
cando.en.a2.u20.identify: Bisa njlentrehake wong, papan, utawa barang kanthi persis kanthi nambahake katrangan nganggo 'who', 'which', utawa 'that'.
cando.en.a2.u21.possession: Bisa nyebutake apa sing diduweni dhewe lan wong liya tanpa ngambali kata bendane, kanthi nganggo 'mine', 'yours', 'his', 'hers', 'ours', lan 'theirs'.
cando.en.a2.u21.reflexive: Bisa nyebutake nalika wong sing padha nindakake lan nampa tumindak, kanthi nganggo 'myself', 'yourself', lan pronomina -self/-selves liyane.
cando.en.a2.u22.opinions: Bisa menehi panemu karo alesan, nambahake asil, lan nggawe pertentangan, kanthi nganggo 'because', 'so', lan 'although'.
cando.en.a2.u23.navigation: Bisa menehi lan ngetutake pituduh dalan sakubenge kutha, kanthi nganggo 'into', 'through', 'across', 'along', 'past', lan 'over' kanggo nuduhake gerakan.
cando.en.a2.u24.events: Bisa takon lan mangsuli pitakonan rinci babagan kedadeyan bubar iki — sapa sing nindakake, apa sing kedadeyan, lan kenapa — kanthi milih urutan tembung sing bener kanggo pitakonan subjek lan objek.
cando.en.a2.u25.celebrations: Bisa njlentrehake pahargyan saka budayane dhewe, mbandhingake karo sing liya, lan nyebutake apa sing disenengi.
cando.en.a2.u26.review: Bisa nggandhengake apa sing wis kedadeyan, apa sing diwajibake, lan apa sing disenengi ing siji crita.
cando.en.a2.u27.my-year: Bisa menehi crita lisan lan tulisan cekak babagan taune: apa sing kedadeyan, apa sing wis owah, lan apa sing bakal teka.
cando.en.a2.u28.show: Bisa nggandhengake kabeh materi Arc 2 ing siji sesi review.
cando.en.b1.u01.past-habits: Bisa njlentrehake pakulinan lan kegiyatan kepungkur sing wis ora bener maneh, kanthi nganggo 'used to' lan 'would'.
cando.en.b1.u01.story: Bisa nyritakake crita sing nggandhengake katrangan latar mburi karo kedadeyan-kedadeyan kanthi urut.
cando.en.b1.u02.order: Bisa nata rong kedadeyan kepungkur kanthi urut, nuduhake endi sing luwih dhisik.
cando.en.b1.u02.what-had-happened: Bisa nyebutake apa sing wis kedadeyan sadurunge nyadari sawijining bab.
cando.en.b1.u03.duration: Bisa nyebutake sepira wis lawase sawijining bab lumaku, kanthi nganggo 'for' lan 'since'.
cando.en.b1.u03.result-or-activity: Bisa mbedakake asil sing wis rampung karo kegiyatan sing bisa uga isih lumaku.
cando.en.b1.u04.articles: Bisa nggunakake aturan artikel sing luwih njlimet — 'the' kanggo superlatif utawa barang sing khas dhewe, tanpa artikel kanggo panganan lan basa, 'a/an' kanggo pegaweyan lan tarif.
cando.en.b1.u04.best-ever: Bisa nyebutake pengalaman minangka sing paling apik utawa paling ala kanthi superlatif digandhengake present perfect lan 'ever'.
cando.en.b1.u05.future-in-progress: Bisa njlentrehake apa sing bakal ditindakake ing sawijining wektu tartamtu ing mangsa ngarep.
cando.en.b1.u05.suggestions-offers: Bisa nggawe usulan lan tawaran kanthi 'Shall we' lan 'Shall I'.
cando.en.b1.u06.hypotheticals: Bisa mbayangke wektu saiki utawa mangsa ngarep sing ora nyata kanthi 'if' ditambah wujud past lan 'would', sarta menehi alesan.
cando.en.b1.u06.real-or-imagined: Bisa mbedakake kamungkinan sing nyata karo sing mung pangan-angen, milih antarane 'if' karo 'will' lan 'if' karo 'would'.
cando.en.b1.u07.if-only: Bisa nggawe pangarep-arep luwih jero kanthi nganggo 'if only'.
cando.en.b1.u07.wishes: Bisa nyebutake pangarep-arep babagan kahanan saiki, kanthi nganggo 'wish' karo wujud past kanggo nuduhake yen kuwi ora nyata.
cando.en.b1.u08.prepare-in-case: Bisa nyawisake awake dhewe kanggo kamungkinan kanthi 'in case', lan nemtokake syarat kanthi 'as long as'.
cando.en.b1.u08.warn-unless: Bisa ngelingake babagan asil sing gumantung syarat, kanthi nganggo 'unless'.
cando.en.b1.u09.deduction: Bisa nimbang sepira yakine sawijining bab lan njlentrehake buktine, kanthi nganggo 'must', 'might', lan 'can't be'.
cando.en.b1.u10.obligation-past: Bisa nyebutake apa sing kudu ditindakake ing wektu kepungkur lan apa sing bakal kudu ditindakake ing mangsa ngarep.
cando.en.b1.u10.permission-any-tense: Bisa ngrembug apa sing diijinake utawa ora, ing wektu apa wae.
cando.en.b1.u11.made-or-let: Bisa nyebutake apa sing digawe utawa diwenehi ijin dening wong liya, lan apa sing digawe utawa diwenehi ijin marang wong liya.
cando.en.b1.u11.want-someone-to: Bisa nyebutake apa sing dikarepake, dijaluk, dikandhakake, utawa diarep-arep saka wong liya.
cando.en.b1.u12.processes: Bisa njlentrehake kepiye sawijining bab digawe, dienggo, utawa diasilake, tanpa perlu nyebutake sapa sing nglakoni, kanthi nganggo present passive.
cando.en.b1.u13.built: Bisa njlentrehake kapan lan kepiye sawijining bab dibangun, digawe, ditulis, utawa ditemokake, kanthi nganggo past passive.
cando.en.b1.u13.passive-by: Bisa nambahake sing nglakoni ing ukara pasif kepungkur kanthi 'by', mung yen katrangan kuwi penting.
cando.en.b1.u14.report-speech: Bisa nyritakake apa sing diomongake wong liya, kanthi mundurake wektune kanthi trep.
cando.en.b1.u14.say-or-tell: Bisa milih kanthi bener antarane 'say' lan 'tell' nalika nyritakake omongan wong liya.
cando.en.b1.u15.reported-questions: Bisa nyritakake apa sing ditakokake wong liya, njaga pitakonan yes/no kanthi 'if' utawa 'whether' lan pitakonan wh- ing urutan pernyataan biasa.
cando.en.b1.u15.reported-requests: Bisa nyritakake apa sing dikandhakake utawa dijaluk wong liya, kanthi nganggo 'tell' utawa 'ask' ditambah objek lan to-infinitive.
cando.en.b1.u16.drop-relative: Bisa ngilangi 'who', 'which', utawa 'that' nalika dadi objek ing katrangan tambahan, kaya ing "the neighborhood I love."
cando.en.b1.u16.where-whose: Bisa nerangake papan kanthi 'where' utawa wong kanthi 'whose', kaya ing "the street where I live" lan "a neighbor whose garden is full of flowers."
cando.en.b1.u17.verb-pattern-contrast: Bisa milih kanthi bener antarane -ing lan 'to' sawise 'remember', 'stop', lan 'try', sarta ngerti kepiye tegese owah.
cando.en.b1.u18.phrasal-idioms: Bisa nganggo phrasal verb sing lumrah nanging tegese ora kena ditebak saka tembung-tembunge — 'find out', 'give up', 'run out' — kanggo ngrampungake masalah saben dina.
cando.en.b1.u18.phrasal-separable: Bisa nyelehake pronomina ing tengah phrasal verb sing bisa dipisah, kaya 'turn it on' utawa 'put it away'.
cando.en.b1.u19.linking: Bisa nggandhengake gagasan antar ukara kanthi 'however', 'therefore', lan 'instead' kanggo mbedakake utawa nggawe kesimpulan.
cando.en.b1.u19.purpose: Bisa nyebutake tujuan kanthi luwih lengkap, kanthi nganggo 'in order to' lan 'so that'.
cando.en.b1.u20.echoes: Bisa setuju karo omongan wong liya kanthi nyoraki kriyane nganggo 'so' utawa 'neither'.
cando.en.b1.u20.tags: Bisa mriksa utawa mesthekake sawijining bab kanthi question tag cekak ing pungkasan ukara.
cando.en.b1.u21.indefinites: Bisa ngrembug wong, barang, lan papan sing ora spesifik, kanthi nganggo tembung some-, any-, no-, lan every- kanthi bener bebarengan.
cando.en.b1.u22.reactions: Bisa nanggepi sawijining bab sing dideleng utawa dirungokake lan njlentrehake kenapa, milih kanthi bener antarane wujud adjektiva -ed lan -ing.
cando.en.b1.u23.results: Bisa njlentrehake asil sing digawe ing njero katrangan — 'too slow to catch it', 'so strong that it broke', 'such a close game' — kanthi nganggo 'too...to', 'so...that', lan 'such a'.
cando.en.b1.u24.indirect-questions: Bisa njaluk informasi kanthi sopan, ngalusake pitakonan kanthi 'Could you tell me', 'Do you know', utawa 'I was wondering'.
cando.en.b1.u25.pairs: Bisa nyebutake apa sawijining bab bener kanggo loro-lorone wong utawa barang, mung siji, utawa ora loro-lorone, kanthi nganggo 'both', 'either', lan 'neither'.
cando.en.b1.u25.preferences: Bisa nyebutake endi sing luwih disenengi saka rong barang, lan takon marang wong liya endi sing luwih dikarepake.
cando.en.b1.u26.work-life: Bisa ngrembug pegaweyan, karier, lan kanca kerja, sarta bisa nyritakake maneh wawancara kerja saka kaloro sisih — mangsuli pitakonan lan nyritakake apa sing ditakokake lan diomongake.
cando.en.b1.u27.big-questions: Bisa njupuk sikap babagan pitakonan gedhe, ndhukung kanthi pangan-angen lan alesan, sarta nggandhengake gagasan kanthi 'however/therefore' lan dugaan.
cando.en.b1.u28.review: Bisa nggandhengake crita, kahanan pangan-angen, omongan wong liya, lan panemune dhewe ing siji crita.
cando.en.b1.u29.five-stories: Bisa menehi portofolio lisan lan tulisan cekak: crita kepungkur karo siji kedadeyan past perfect, pangan-angen, pacelathon sing dicritakake maneh, katrangan proses pasif, lan panemu kanthi tembung panggandheng.
cando.en.b1.u30.show: Bisa nggandhengake kabeh materi Arc 3 ing siji sesi review.
gn.en.gn.adj-ed-ing.note: Wujud -ing njlentrehake apa sing nyebabake perasaan; wujud -ed njlentrehake perasaane dhewe: "the film is boring, so I'm bored."
gn.en.gn.adj-ed-ing.title: Adjektiva -ed utawa -ing
gn.en.gn.adv-degree.note: Very, really, quite, lan too manggon sadurunge adjektiva kanggo nambah utawa ngurangi kekuwatane: "really tired, quite good, too late."
gn.en.gn.adv-degree.title: Kata keterangan tingkat
gn.en.gn.adv-freq.note: Tembung-tembung kaya 'usually', 'often', lan 'sometimes' nuduhake sepira kerepe sawijining pakulinan. Tembung-tembung iki manggon sadurunge kriya utama lan sawise 'be': "I usually walk. She is often late."
gn.en.gn.adv-freq.title: Kata keterangan frekuensi
gn.en.gn.adv-manner.note: Tambahake -ly kanggo njlentrehake kepiye tumindak ditindakake: "She speaks slowly." Sawetara tetep nganggo wujud dhewe — well, fast, hard.
gn.en.gn.adv-manner.title: Kata keterangan cara
gn.en.gn.art-the.note: 'The' tegese sing wis padha dingerteni: "the station", "the sun", utawa sebutan kaping pindho. Jamak umum ora nggunakake 'the': "I like dogs."
gn.en.gn.art-the.title: the (dhasar)
gn.en.gn.articles-a-an.note: Gunakake 'a' sadurunge swara konsonan lan 'an' sadurunge swara vokal: a book, an apple, an hour. Iki nuduhake siji barang sing ora spesifik.
gn.en.gn.articles-a-an.title: a / an
gn.en.gn.articles-deep.note: 'The' nuduhake barang sing unik, superlatif, utawa kali; tanpa artikel kanggo panganan, basa, lan meh kabeh jeneng dalan; 'a' utawa 'an' kanggo pakaryan lan tarif: "the fastest, breakfast, twice a day."
gn.en.gn.articles-deep.title: Artikel: aturan sing luwih njlimet
gn.en.gn.as-as.note: "As … as" nuduhake rong barang sing padha (as tall as me), lan "not as … as" nuduhake sing siji luwih kurang: "It's not as cheap as before."
gn.en.gn.as-as.title: as … as (mbandhingake sing padha)
gn.en.gn.be-1sg-2sg.note: 'Am' digunakake karo 'I', lan 'are' digunakake karo 'you': "I am Anna. You are my friend." Rong wujud iki digunakake kanggo pambuka pisanan.
gn.en.gn.be-1sg-2sg.title: be: I am / you are
gn.en.gn.be-all.note: 'Am', 'is', lan 'are' kanggo kabeh subjek: 'he', 'she', lan 'it' nggunakake 'is'; 'we', 'you', lan 'they' nggunakake 'are'. "She is a doctor. They are from Peru."
gn.en.gn.be-all.title: be: wujud present lengkap
gn.en.gn.be-allowed-to.note: "Be allowed to" nuduhake ijin ing wektu apa wae: "We weren't allowed to talk in class. You're allowed to park here."
gn.en.gn.be-allowed-to.title: be allowed to (oleh ijin)
gn.en.gn.be-neg.note: Tambahake 'not' sawise 'be': "I am not tired. She isn't here." Wujud cekak 'isn't' lan 'aren't' luwih lumrah ing pacelathon.
gn.en.gn.be-neg.title: be: ukara negatif
gn.en.gn.be-yesno-q.note: Walik 'be' menyang ngarep: "You are tired." dadi "Are you tired?" Urutan tembung wae wis nggawe dadi pitakonan — ora perlu tembung tambahan.
gn.en.gn.be-yesno-q.title: Pitakonan Yes/No karo be
gn.en.gn.can-ability.note: "I can swim. He can't drive." Siji wujud kanggo saben subjek, lan kriya sawise 'can' tetep wujud dhasar.
gn.en.gn.can-ability.title: can / can't (kemampuan)
gn.en.gn.can-request.note: "Can I have the menu? Can you help me?" — panjaluk sopan saben dina, kanggo ijin lan pitulungan.
gn.en.gn.can-request.title: can (panjaluk)
gn.en.gn.comp-adverbs.note: Kanggo mbandhingake kepiye tumindak ditindakake, gunakake 'more', '-er', utawa wujud ora teratur karo 'than': "She types more quickly. He runs faster. They play better than us."
gn.en.gn.comp-adverbs.title: Kata keterangan komparatif
gn.en.gn.comp-superl.note: Adjektiva cekak nggunakake -er lan -est (older, the oldest); sing dawa nggunakake 'more' lan 'most'. 'Good' dadi 'better' lan 'best'. Bandhingake karo 'than': "My city is bigger than yours."
gn.en.gn.comp-superl.title: Komparatif & Superlatif
gn.en.gn.cond-first-vs-second.note: First conditional nimbang rencana sing bisa kelakon; second conditional mbayangke bab sing meh ora bisa kelakon: "If it rains, we'll stay in" dibandhingake "If I won the lottery, I'd travel."
gn.en.gn.cond-first-vs-second.title: Nyata apa mung pangan-angen?
gn.en.gn.cond-first.note: If ditambah present, will, kanggo kamungkinan mangsa ngarep sing nyata: "If it rains, we'll stay in." 'Will' ora dienggo ing bageyan if.
gn.en.gn.cond-first.title: First conditional (kahanan nyata)
gn.en.gn.cond-second.note: If ditambah wujud past, banjur would ditambah kriya, mbayangke wektu saiki utawa mangsa ngarep sing ora nyata: "If I had more time, I would travel."
gn.en.gn.cond-second.title: Second conditional (kahanan mokal)
gn.en.gn.cond-zero.note: If ditambah present, present, kanggo bab-bab sing umume bener: "If you heat ice, it melts." Kaloro bageyan tetep nganggo present.
gn.en.gn.cond-zero.title: Zero conditional (kahanan umum)
gn.en.gn.conn-basic.note: Gabungake gagasan: "I like tea and coffee. It's small but nice. I stayed home because I was tired."
gn.en.gn.conn-basic.title: and / but / because
gn.en.gn.conn-discourse.note: However, therefore, lan instead nggandhengake siji ukara menyang ukara sabanjure: "It was late. However, we kept going."
gn.en.gn.conn-discourse.title: however / therefore / instead (tembung panggandheng)
gn.en.gn.could-past-polite.note: Could nuduhake kemampuan ing wektu kepungkur ("I could swim at five") lan nggawe panjaluk luwih alus ing wektu saiki ("Could you help me?").
gn.en.gn.could-past-polite.title: could (wangun sopan)
gn.en.gn.count-uncount.note: Sawetara kata benda — water, money, rice — dianggep minangka barang sing ora bisa diitung: ora ana -s jamak lan ora ana 'a' ing ngarepe. Liyane diitung siji-siji kaya biasane.
gn.en.gn.count-uncount.title: Bisa diitung & ora bisa diitung
gn.en.gn.dem-sg.note: 'This' nuduhake barang sing cedhak karo sampeyan lan 'that' nuduhake barang sing luwih adoh: "This is my phone. That is your bag."
gn.en.gn.dem-sg.title: this / that
gn.en.gn.do-neg.note: "I don't know. She doesn't eat meat." 'Don't' utawa 'doesn't' ditambah kriya dhasar — akhiran -s pindhah menyang 'does' lan ninggalake kriya.
gn.en.gn.do-neg.title: Ukara negatif karo don't/doesn't
gn.en.gn.do-quest.note: "Do you like tea? Does she work here?" 'Do' utawa 'does' miwiti pitakonan lan kriya utama tetep ing wujud dhasar.
gn.en.gn.do-quest.title: Pitakonan karo do/does
gn.en.gn.dummy-it.note: Basa Inggris mbutuhake subjek sanajan kanggo cuaca lan wektu: "It is raining. It's cold. It's late." Tembung 'it' ora nuduhake apa-apa — mung ngisi posisi subjek.
gn.en.gn.dummy-it.title: it kanggo cuaca & wektu
gn.en.gn.echo-so-neither.note: Setuju kanthi mbaleni kriya pambantu: "I love it." "So do I." Wangsulan positif nganggo 'so', wangsulan negatif nganggo 'neither'.
gn.en.gn.echo-so-neither.title: So do I / Neither do I (melu setuju)
gn.en.gn.few-little.note: 'A few' dienggo karo kata benda sing bisa diitung lan 'a little' karo sing ora bisa diitung; yen 'a'-ne dilebur, 'few' utawa 'little' nuduhake kurang cukup: "a few friends" dibandhingake "few friends."
gn.en.gn.few-little.title: (a) few / (a) little (sethithik)
gn.en.gn.for-since.note: 'For' ngukur dawane wektu (for two years); 'since' nyebutake wiwitane (since 2020). Kaloro-loro lumrahe dienggo bareng present perfect.
gn.en.gn.for-since.title: for / since (suwene / wiwit kapan)
gn.en.gn.future-cont.note: 'Will be' ditambah -ing nggambarake tumindak sing lagi lumaku ing sawijining wektu ing mangsa ngarep: "This time tomorrow I'll be flying."
gn.en.gn.future-cont.title: Future continuous (lagi lumaku ing mangsa ngarep)
gn.en.gn.gerund-after-verbs.note: Sawise like, love, hate, enjoy, mind, lan stop, kriya sabanjure nganggo -ing: "I enjoy cooking. Do you mind waiting?"
gn.en.gn.gerund-after-verbs.title: kriya + -ing
gn.en.gn.going-to.note: 'Be' ditambah 'going to' ditambah kriya kanggo rencana: "I'm going to visit my aunt tomorrow. We're going to travel in June."
gn.en.gn.going-to.title: going to (rencana)
gn.en.gn.had-to.note: Kewajiban owah miturut wektu: "I had to wear a uniform" nuduhake wektu kepungkur, "You'll have to book early" nuduhake mangsa ngarep.
gn.en.gn.had-to.title: had to / will have to (kapeksa, kepungkur & mangsa ngarep)
gn.en.gn.have-got.note: Kepemilikan: "I have two brothers. She has a car." Sampeyan uga bisa krungu 'have got' — anggep tegese padha.
gn.en.gn.have-got.title: have / has
gn.en.gn.have-to.note: 'Have to' nuduhake kewajiban; 'don't have to' tegese ora ana kewajiban — dudu tegese dilarang: "I have to work" dibandhingake "You don't have to come."
gn.en.gn.have-to.title: have to / don't have to (kudu / ora perlu)
gn.en.gn.how-much-many.note: 'How many' kanggo barang sing bisa diitung ("How many apples?") lan 'how much' kanggo barang sing ora bisa diitung ("How much water?"). Rega nggunakake "How much is it?"
gn.en.gn.how-much-many.title: How much / How many
gn.en.gn.if-only.note: "If only" nggawe pangarep-arep luwih jero tinimbang biasa: "If only it were warmer." Iki nganggo wujud past sing padha karo 'wish'.
gn.en.gn.if-only.title: If only (pangarep-arep sing durung kelakon)
gn.en.gn.imperatives.note: Kandhani wong liya apa sing kudu ditindakake kanthi kriya dhasar: "Turn left. Wait here. Please don't stop." Nambahake 'please' nggawe luwih sopan.
gn.en.gn.imperatives.title: Ukara prentah
gn.en.gn.in-case-as-long-as.note: 'In case' nyawisake awake dhewe kanggo kamungkinan ("take an umbrella in case it rains"); 'as long as' nemtokake syarat ("you can stay as long as you're quiet").
gn.en.gn.in-case-as-long-as.title: in case / as long as (jaga-jaga / anggere)
gn.en.gn.in-order-to.note: "In order to" lan "so that" njlentrehake tujuan kanthi luwih lengkap: "in order to save time, so that everyone can hear."
gn.en.gn.in-order-to.title: in order to / so that (kanggo tujuan)
gn.en.gn.indef-pronouns.note: Gabungake some-, any-, no-, lan every- karo body, thing, lan where, tetep nganggo aturan some/any sing padha: "someone called, but nobody answered."
gn.en.gn.indef-pronouns.title: somebody / anything / nowhere (pronomina ora spesifik)
gn.en.gn.indirect-questions.note: Ing pitakonan sing luwih sopan, urutan tembunge bali dadi kaya ukara biasa: "Where is the station?" dadi "Could you tell me where the station is?"
gn.en.gn.indirect-questions.title: Could you tell me where…? (pitakonan ora langsung sing sopan)
gn.en.gn.infinitive-after-verbs.note: Sawise want, need, hope, decide, lan would like, kriya sabanjure nganggo "to": "I want to go. She decided to stay."
gn.en.gn.infinitive-after-verbs.title: kriya + to-infinitive
gn.en.gn.infinitive-purpose.note: "To + kriya" mangsuli pitakonan kenapa sampeyan nindakake sawijining bab: "I came to help." Tegese padha karo "in order to."
gn.en.gn.infinitive-purpose.title: Infinitive kanggo tujuan
gn.en.gn.like-want-noun.note: Kriya ditambah barang, ora ana tembung ing antarane: "I like coffee. I want water." Wong sing seneng iku subjek.
gn.en.gn.like-want-noun.title: like / want + kata benda
gn.en.gn.make-let.note: Sawise make lan let, objeke dituruti kriya dhasar tanpa "to": "They made us wait. She let me drive."
gn.en.gn.make-let.title: make / let + bare verb (kriya tanpa 'to')
gn.en.gn.might-may.note: Might lan may nuduhake kamungkinan, dudu kepastian: "It might rain. She may be late." Kaloro-loro ninggalake asile durung mesthi.
gn.en.gn.might-may.title: might / may (bisa uga)
gn.en.gn.modal-deduction.note: Modal bisa nuduhake sepira yakine sampeyan: "It must be cold out. She can't be home yet. He might be busy." Kriyane nyocogake karo bukti sing ana.
gn.en.gn.modal-deduction.title: must / might / can't be (nduga-duga)
gn.en.gn.much-many-alot.note: 'Many' dienggo karo kata benda sing bisa diitung, 'much' karo sing ora bisa diitung, lan 'a lot of' bisa dienggo kanggo kaloro-loro: "many books, much time, a lot of either."
gn.en.gn.much-many-alot.title: much / many / a lot of (akeh)
gn.en.gn.must-mustnt.note: 'Must' nuduhake aturan sing kuwat; 'mustn't' nuduhake larangan, beda karo 'don't have to': "You mustn't park here."
gn.en.gn.must-mustnt.title: must / mustn't (kudu / ora kena)
gn.en.gn.narrative-tenses.note: Crita nganggo past simple kanggo kedadeyan, past continuous kanggo latar mburi, lan tembung urutan kaya first, then, lan finally kanggo nerusake critane: "I was walking home when I saw her, so I stopped."
gn.en.gn.narrative-tenses.title: Nyritakake crita nganggo wektu kepungkur
gn.en.gn.numbers-1-100.note: Ngitung nganti satus lan waspadai jebakan -teen lawan -ty: 'thirteen' lan 'thirty' swarane meh padha, dadi penekanan sing mbedakake.
gn.en.gn.numbers-1-100.title: Angka 1–100
gn.en.gn.obj-pron.note: Me, you, him, her, it, us, them — tembung-tembung iki teka sawise kriya: "Call me. I see her. Ask him."
gn.en.gn.obj-pron.title: Pronomina Objek
gn.en.gn.passive-by.note: Sebutake sing nglakoni nganggo "by" mung yen katrangan kuwi penting: "It was painted by my sister." Yen ora, ukara pasif bisa ora nyebutake sing nglakoni.
gn.en.gn.passive-by.title: by + sing nglakoni
gn.en.gn.passive-past.note: Pasif wektu kepungkur nggandhengake 'was' utawa 'were' karo past participle: "The bridge was built in 1900. The letters were sent yesterday."
gn.en.gn.passive-past.title: Pasif wektu kepungkur
gn.en.gn.passive-present.note: 'Be' ditambah past participle mindhah perhatian menyang apa sing kedadeyan, dudu sapa sing nglakoni: "Rice is grown here." Sing nglakoni bisa ora disebutake.
gn.en.gn.passive-present.title: Pasif wektu saiki
gn.en.gn.past-be.note: Wujud past saka 'be': 'I', 'he', 'she', lan 'it' nggunakake 'was'; 'you', 'we', lan 'they' nggunakake 'were'. "I was at home. They were happy."
gn.en.gn.past-be.title: was / were
gn.en.gn.past-cont.note: Gunakake 'was' utawa 'were' ditambah kriya -ing kanggo bab sing lagi lumaku ing wektu kepungkur: "I was cooking when you called." Iki nggambarake kahanan, dudu nyritakake kedadeyan sing wis rampung.
gn.en.gn.past-cont.title: Past continuous (lagi lumaku ing wektu kepungkur)
gn.en.gn.past-irreg-top25.note: Kriya sing paling umum owah wujude ing past tense: 'go' dadi 'went', 'have' dadi 'had', 'see' dadi 'saw', 'do' dadi 'did', 'get' dadi 'got', 'make' dadi 'made'.
gn.en.gn.past-irreg-top25.title: Past tense ora teratur (kriya utama)
gn.en.gn.past-perfect-vs-past.note: Past perfect nuduhake kedadeyan sing luwih dhisik; sawise before, after, utawa by the time, urutane wis cetha tanpa perlu past perfect: "After she left, we ate."
gn.en.gn.past-perfect-vs-past.title: Urutan kedadeyan wektu kepungkur
gn.en.gn.past-perfect.note: 'Had' ditambah past participle nuduhake kedadeyan sing luwih dhisik saka rong kedadeyan kepungkur: "The train had left when I arrived." Iki mundur sithik maneh ing wektu.
gn.en.gn.past-perfect.title: Past perfect (wis kelakon sadurunge liyane)
gn.en.gn.past-quest-neg.note: "Did you see it? I didn't go." 'Did' nggawa teges past, dadi kriya utama bali menyang wujud dhasar.
gn.en.gn.past-quest-neg.title: did: pitakonan & negatif
gn.en.gn.past-reg.note: Tambahake -ed kanggo tumindak sing wis rampung: "I worked. She visited her mother." Wujud sing padha digunakake kanggo saben subjek.
gn.en.gn.past-reg.title: Past simple: -ed
gn.en.gn.past-simple-vs-cont.note: Tumindak latar mburi sing luwih dawa (was/were + -ing) asring kesela dening tumindak cepet ing past simple, digandhengake nganggo 'when' utawa 'while': "I was reading when the lights went out."
gn.en.gn.past-simple-vs-cont.title: Kedadeyan kepungkur sing kesela
gn.en.gn.perf-cont-vs-simple.note: "I've painted the room" nuduhake asil sing wis rampung; "I've been painting" nuduhake kegiyatane, sing bisa uga isih lumaku. Sing siji nitik asile, sing liya nitik usahane.
gn.en.gn.perf-cont-vs-simple.title: Asil apa lawase?
gn.en.gn.phrasal-separable.note: Sawetara phrasal verb bisa dipisah nganggo objeke, lan pronomina manggon ing tengah: "turn the light on" utawa "turn it on."
gn.en.gn.phrasal-separable.title: Phrasal verb sing bisa dipisah
gn.en.gn.phrasal-verbs-1.note: Kriya ditambah tembung cilik bisa ngganti tegese: get up, turn on, look for, put on. Pasangan iki dianggep siji tegesan.
gn.en.gn.phrasal-verbs-1.title: Phrasal verbs I (dhasar)
gn.en.gn.phrasal-verbs-2.note: Pasangan liya sing asring dienggo — find out, give up, carry on, look after, run out of, sort out — tegese ora bisa ditebak saka tembung-tembung sing mbentuk.
gn.en.gn.phrasal-verbs-2.title: Phrasal verbs II (lanjutan)
gn.en.gn.plural-irreg.note: Sawetara kata benda owah tinimbang nambah -s: 'man' dadi 'men', 'woman' dadi 'women', 'child' dadi 'children', 'person' dadi 'people', 'foot' dadi 'feet'.
gn.en.gn.plural-irreg.title: Jamak ora teratur
gn.en.gn.plural-reg.note: Tambahake -s kanggo luwih saka siji, utawa -es sawise s, sh, ch, lan x: one cat, two cats; one box, two boxes.
gn.en.gn.plural-reg.title: Jamak teratur
gn.en.gn.poss-adj.note: My, your, his, her, its, our, their — lebokake sadurunge kata benda: "her book", "our house", "their names".
gn.en.gn.poss-adj.title: Adjektiva posesif
gn.en.gn.poss-pron.note: Mine, yours, his, hers, ours, lan theirs ngadeg dhewe tanpa kata benda ing mburine: "That book is mine."
gn.en.gn.poss-pron.title: Pronomina posesif
gn.en.gn.poss-s.note: Tambahake 's marang sing duwe: "Anna's dog", "my brother's car". Basa Inggris nyelehake sing duwe dhisik lan barang sing diduweni kapindho.
gn.en.gn.poss-s.title: Posesif 's
gn.en.gn.prep-movement.note: Into, out of, through, across, along, past, lan over njlentrehake arah lakune, dudu panggonan sing tetep: "walk through the park, across the bridge."
gn.en.gn.prep-movement.title: Preposisi gerakan
gn.en.gn.prep-place.note: In, on, under, next to, behind, in front of, between — tembung-tembung cilik sing nuduhake panggonan: "The keys are on the table."
gn.en.gn.prep-place.title: Preposisi panggonan
gn.en.gn.pres-cont-future.note: Present continuous bisa nuduhake rencana sing wis mesthi karo wektu sing wis ditemtokake: "I'm meeting Ana at six." Tembung wektune sing nggawe ora krasa kaya kedadeyan saiki.
gn.en.gn.pres-cont-future.title: Present continuous kanggo rencana sing wis mesthi
gn.en.gn.pres-cont.note: 'Be' ditambah kriya-ing kanggo saiki: "I am eating. They are working. Look, it is raining."
gn.en.gn.pres-cont.title: Present continuous
gn.en.gn.pres-perf-been-gone.note: "Has been to" tegese wis lunga lan bali maneh; "has gone to" tegese isih ana ing kono: "She has been to Paris" dibandhingake "She has gone to Paris."
gn.en.gn.pres-perf-been-gone.title: been vs gone (wis mulih apa durung)
gn.en.gn.pres-perf-cont.note: 'Have/has been' ditambah -ing njlentrehake tumindak sing isih lumaku utawa lagi wae mandheg: "I've been waiting for an hour." Iki nekanake dawane wektu kegiyatane.
gn.en.gn.pres-perf-cont.title: Present perfect continuous (isih lumaku nganti saiki)
gn.en.gn.pres-perf-exp.note: 'Have/has' ditambah past participle ngrembug babagan pengalaman urip tanpa nyebutake kapan: "I have visited Rome." Sing penting dudu wektune, nanging pengalamane.
gn.en.gn.pres-perf-exp.title: Present perfect: pengalaman
gn.en.gn.pres-perf-vs-past.note: Tembung wektu sing wis rampung (yesterday, last week) mbutuhake past simple; wektu sing durung rampung utawa ora disebutake nganggo present perfect. "I saw it yesterday" nanging "I have seen it."
gn.en.gn.pres-perf-vs-past.title: Isih ana gandhengane karo saiki, apa wis rampung?
gn.en.gn.pres-perf-yet-already.note: 'Already' nuduhake bab sing rampung luwih cepet tinimbang sing dikira, 'yet' dienggo ing pitakonan lan ukara negatif, lan 'just' nuduhake kedadeyan sing lagi wae kelakon: "I've just eaten. Have you finished yet?"
gn.en.gn.pres-perf-yet-already.title: already / yet / just (wektu cedhak saiki)
gn.en.gn.pres-simple-3sg.note: Kanthi 'he', 'she', lan 'it', kriya nggunakake -s: "She works. He watches." Iki minangka huruf sing paling asring dilalekake ing basa Inggris, dadi kudu luwih digatekake.
gn.en.gn.pres-simple-3sg.title: Orang ketiga -s
gn.en.gn.pres-simple-base.note: Kanggo pakulinan lan fakta, gunakake kriya dhasar: "I work at home. They live in Lima." Ora ana owah-owahan akhiran kanggo subjek-subjek iki.
gn.en.gn.pres-simple-base.title: Present simple: I / you / we / they
gn.en.gn.pron-subject.note: I, you, he, she, it, we, they. Basa Inggris mbutuhake subjek diucapake kanthi cetha ing meh saben ukara — "am tired" mbutuhake 'I'.
gn.en.gn.pron-subject.title: Pronomina Subjek
gn.en.gn.question-tags.note: Question tag nyontoni kriya pambantune lan mbalik tandane: "It's cold, isn't it? You don't mind, do you?"
gn.en.gn.question-tags.title: Question tags (pitakonan cekak ing pungkasan)
gn.en.gn.question-words-deep.note: Yen tembung pitakon dadi subjek, 'do' ora perlu: "Who called you?" Yen dadi objek, 'do' tetep dienggo: "Who did you call?" Bandhingake "What happened?"
gn.en.gn.question-words-deep.title: Pitakonan subjek lan objek
gn.en.gn.reflexive.note: Yen subjek lan objeke padha, gunakake myself, yourself, herself, lan sapanunggalane: "I hurt myself. Help yourselves."
gn.en.gn.reflexive.title: Pronomina refleksif
gn.en.gn.rel-object-omit.note: Yen tembung relatife dadi objek, basa Inggris ngidini dilebur: "the film we watched" padha karo "the film that we watched."
gn.en.gn.rel-object-omit.title: Ngilangi tembung relatif
gn.en.gn.rel-where-whose.note: 'Where' nuduhake panggonan lan 'whose' nuduhake sing duwe: "the town where I grew up, the writer whose book won."
gn.en.gn.rel-where-whose.title: Relatif: where / whose
gn.en.gn.rel-who-which.note: Gunakake 'who' kanggo wong lan 'which' utawa 'that' kanggo barang, kanggo nambahake katrangan sing penting: "the man who lives here, the bag that fits."
gn.en.gn.rel-who-which.title: Klausa relatif (nerangake)
gn.en.gn.reported-commands.note: Nyritakake panjaluk utawa prentah nganggo tell utawa ask ditambah objek lan to-infinitive: "She told me to wait. He asked us not to call."
gn.en.gn.reported-commands.title: Panjaluk & prentah ora langsung
gn.en.gn.reported-questions.note: Pitakonan ora langsung ora nganggo urutan pitakonan lan diwaca kaya pernyataan: "Where do you live?" dadi "He asked where I lived." Gunakake 'if' utawa 'whether' kanggo pitakonan yes/no.
gn.en.gn.reported-questions.title: Pitakonan ora langsung
gn.en.gn.reported-statements.note: Kanggo nyritakake apa sing diomongake wong liya, wektune mundur siji tingkat: "I'm tired" dadi "She said (that) she was tired."
gn.en.gn.reported-statements.title: Ukara ora langsung: pernyataan
gn.en.gn.say-vs-tell.note: 'Tell' mbutuhake wong persis sawise (tell me); 'say' ora (say that…): "She told me the news" nanging "She said the news was good."
gn.en.gn.say-vs-tell.title: say / tell (ngomong / crita marang)
gn.en.gn.shall-suggest.note: 'Shall' karo I utawa we kanggo nawakake utawa ngusulake: "Shall we start? Shall I open the window?"
gn.en.gn.shall-suggest.title: Shall we…? (ngajak)
gn.en.gn.should-advice.note: 'Should' lan 'shouldn't' menehi pituduh utawa panemu, dituruti kriya dhasar: "You should rest. You shouldn't skip breakfast."
gn.en.gn.should-advice.title: should / shouldn't (pituduh)
gn.en.gn.simple-vs-cont.note: "I drink coffee every day" minangka pakulinan; "I am drinking coffee" minangka kedadeyan ing wektu iki. Tembung-tembung wektu minangka pitunjuk sampeyan.
gn.en.gn.simple-vs-cont.title: Pakulinan utawa saiki?
gn.en.gn.so-because-although.note: 'So' miwiti asil, 'because' alesan, lan 'although' pertentangan: "It was late, so we left. We stayed because it was warm, although it rained."
gn.en.gn.so-because-although.title: so / because / although (sebab, akibat, lan pambeda)
gn.en.gn.some-any.note: 'Some' ing ukara positif ("I have some money") lan 'any' ing ukara negatif lan pitakonan ("Do you have any money?").
gn.en.gn.some-any.title: some / any
gn.en.gn.superl-perf-ever.note: Superlatif digandhengake karo present perfect lan 'ever' kanggo nyebutake pengalaman sing paling: "It's the best film I have ever seen."
gn.en.gn.superl-perf-ever.title: The best I've ever… (superlatif + present perfect)
gn.en.gn.sv-order.note: Ukara basa Inggris nggunakake urutan Subjek–Kriya–Objek: "I eat apples." Urutan iki nggawa teges, dadi tetepake pelaku dhisik lan tumindak kapindho.
gn.en.gn.sv-order.title: Urutan tembung dhasar
gn.en.gn.there-is-are.note: Kanggo nyebutake anane sawijining barang: "There is a bank. There are two cafes." Cocokake 'is' utawa 'are' karo cacahing barang sing dimaksud.
gn.en.gn.there-is-are.title: there is / there are
gn.en.gn.time-clauses.note: Sawise when, as soon as, before, utawa after, basa Inggris nganggo present tense kanggo tegesan mangsa ngarep: "When I arrive, I'll call you" — dudu "when I will arrive."
gn.en.gn.time-clauses.title: Klausa wektu kanggo mangsa ngarep
gn.en.gn.time-prep.note: 'At' kanggo wektu jam (at five), 'on' kanggo dina lan tanggal (on Monday), 'in' kanggo sasi, taun, lan bagéan dina (in May, in the morning).
gn.en.gn.time-prep.title: at / on / in kanggo wektu
gn.en.gn.time-telling.note: Miwiti kanthi 'It's': "It's three o'clock. It's half past two. It's seven fifteen." Tembung 'it' tetep ana sanajan ora ana sing disebutake.
gn.en.gn.time-telling.title: Nyebutake wektu
gn.en.gn.too-enough.note: 'Too' sadurunge adjektiva tegese luwih akeh tinimbang sing dikarepake (too hot); 'enough' manggon sawise adjektiva nanging sadurunge kata benda (warm enough, enough time).
gn.en.gn.too-enough.title: too / enough (kakehan / cukup)
gn.en.gn.too-to-so-that.note: "Too … to" lan "so … that" nggawe asil saka adjektifa: "too tired to drive, so tired that I slept."
gn.en.gn.too-to-so-that.title: too…to / so…that (akibat)
gn.en.gn.unless.note: 'Unless' tegese if…not: "We'll miss it unless we leave now." Siji tembung wis nggawa kabeh syarat negatif.
gn.en.gn.unless.title: unless (kajaba yen)
gn.en.gn.used-to-vs-would.note: Kaloro-loro 'used to' lan 'would' nyritakake tumindak sing bola-bali ing wektu kepungkur: "We would swim every summer." Nanging kanggo kahanan kepungkur, mung 'used to' sing bisa dienggo, 'would' ora.
gn.en.gn.used-to-vs-would.title: used to / would (pakulinan kepungkur)
gn.en.gn.used-to.note: "Used to" njlentrehake pakulinan utawa kahanan kepungkur sing wis ora ana maneh: "I used to live in Lima." Kriya sabanjure tetep wujud dhasar — used to live, dudu used to lived.
gn.en.gn.used-to.title: used to (pakulinan kepungkur)
gn.en.gn.verb-obj-inf.note: Kriya kaya want, ask, tell, lan expect mbutuhake objek banjur to-infinitive: "I want you to listen. She asked me to wait."
gn.en.gn.verb-obj-inf.title: want someone to do (njaluk wong liya nglakoni)
gn.en.gn.verb-patterns-contrast.note: Karo remember, stop, lan try, pola sing dienggo ngganti tegese: "stop smoking" (mareni) dibandhingake "stop to smoke" (mandheg dhisik kanggo).
gn.en.gn.verb-patterns-contrast.title: remember / stop / try + -ing utawa to (owahe teges)
gn.en.gn.verb-patterns-more.note: Suggest, avoid, mind, lan keep kabeh nganggo -ing: "I suggest leaving early. Keep trying. I don't mind waiting."
gn.en.gn.verb-patterns-more.title: suggest / avoid / mind / keep (+ -ing)
gn.en.gn.verb-prep-collocations.note: Sawetara kriya tansah bareng karo preposisi tartamtu: listen to, wait for, look at, depend on. Pasangan iki luwih apik disinaoni dadi siji.
gn.en.gn.verb-prep-collocations.title: kriya + preposisi
gn.en.gn.wh-quest-be.note: What, where, who, utawa how, banjur 'be', banjur subjek: "Where are you? What is this? Who is that?"
gn.en.gn.wh-quest-be.title: Pitakonan Wh- karo be
gn.en.gn.will-decide-offer.note: Gunakake 'will' nalika mutusake, nawakake, utawa janji sanalika ngomong: "I'll help you. I'll get it." Pilihane ditemtokake sanalika kuwi.
gn.en.gn.will-decide-offer.title: will (mutusan & tawaran)
gn.en.gn.will-predict.note: 'Will' ditambah kriya dhasar nuduhake prediksi utawa fakta babagan mangsa ngarep: "It will rain later." Wujude tetep padha kanggo saben subjek.
gn.en.gn.will-predict.title: will (prediksi)
gn.en.gn.will-vs-going-to.note: 'Going to' cocog kanggo rencana sing wis dipikir utawa bukti sing katon; 'will' cocog kanggo prediksi utawa keputusan sanalika: "We're going to paint" dibandhingake "I'll paint it."
gn.en.gn.will-vs-going-to.title: will vs going to (dadakan apa wis rencana)
gn.en.gn.wish-past.note: Pangarep-arep babagan wektu saiki nganggo wujud past: "I wish I had a garden. I wish I could stay." Wujud past nuduhake yen kuwi ora nyata.
gn.en.gn.wish-past.title: wish + past (pangarep-arep sing ora kelakon)
gn.en.gn.would-like-offers.note: "Would you like…?" nawakake kanthi sopan lan "I'd like…" njaluk sawijining bab kanthi alus: "Would you like a coffee? I'd like to book a table."
gn.en.gn.would-like-offers.title: would you like…? (nawakake kanthi sopan)
gn.en.gn.would-like.note: "I'd like a coffee, please" minangka cara sopan kanggo pesen utawa njaluk sawijining barang — luwih alus tinimbang "I want".
gn.en.gn.would-like.title: I'd like (sopan)
ovl.es.en.a1.u10.note: Sawetara tembung Inggris babagan gawean asring dikleru: 'actually' tegese 'sanyatane', 'assist' tegese 'mbantu', 'exit' tegese 'metu', lan 'carpet' tegese karpet lantai (dudu map/folder).
ovl.es.en.a1.u12.note: Adjektiva ing basa Inggris manggon SADURUNGE kata benda lan ora nganggo akhiran jamak -s: "omah abang" dadi "the red house", dudu "the house reds" utawa "the houses red".
ovl.es.en.a1.u24.note: "Duweke sapa iki?" dadi siji tembung ing basa Inggris: "Whose is this?" — 'whose' nglakoni kabeh gaweyane "duweke sapa".
ovl.es.en.a2.u18.note: Titenana: 'pretend' tegese nyamar (lagi-lagi), dudu 'karep' utawa 'tujuan'; dene 'try' tegese 'nyoba'.
ovl.es.en.a2.u22.note: 'Argue' asring tegese padu utawa mbantah, dudu mung ngrembug. Gunakake 'discuss' kanggo rembugan sing tenang, lan 'argue' kanggo sing panas.
ovl.es.en.b1.u03.note: 'Constipated' tegese angel bebuang, dudu lagi pilek; 'molest' tegese ngganggu kanthi ala, dudu mung ngganggu biasa; 'embarrassed' tegese isin, dudu meteng.
ovl.es.en.b1.u22.note: 'Argument' tegese dhebat utawa alesan, dudu mesthi alur crita; 'success' tegese kasil, dudu kedadeyan; 'sensible' tegese wicaksana lan mlebu akal, dudu perasa banget (sensitive).
ovl.es.en.b1.u26.note: 'Realize' tegese nyadari, dudu nglakoni; 'support' tegese ndhukung, dudu nyangga awak; 'compromise' tegese kompromi utawa prasetyan, gumantung konteks.
ovl.es.en.gn.adj-ed-ing.note: Sawetara basa nganggo siji tembung kanggo 'nggawe bosen' lan 'bosen', nanging basa Inggris misahake: wujud -ing nyebutake sing nyebabake, wujud -ed nyebutake perasaane.
ovl.es.en.gn.adv-freq.note: Ing basa Jawa, tembung kaya 'asring' bisa manggon ing ngendi wae ing ukara; nanging ing basa Inggris, tembung kaya usually/often/sometimes tansah manggon sadurunge kriya utama lan sawise 'be': "I usually walk. She is often late."
ovl.es.en.gn.art-the.note: Pernyataan umum ora nganggo 'the' ing basa Inggris: "Life is beautiful" lan "I like dogs" ora mbutuhake 'the' sadurunge 'life' utawa 'dogs'.
ovl.es.en.gn.articles-a-an.note: Basa Jawa ora nganggo artikel, nanging basa Inggris mbutuhake 'a' utawa 'an' sanajan kanggo pegaweyan: "I am an engineer" — artikel kudu ana.
ovl.es.en.gn.articles-deep.note: Basa Inggris ora nganggo 'the' kanggo jeneng basa lan kata benda umum: "English is useful", dudu "the English is useful."
ovl.es.en.gn.as-as.note: Pola 'padha kaya' ing basa Jawa cedhak karo 'as … as' ing basa Inggris: rong tembung 'as' ngapit adjektivane.
ovl.es.en.gn.be-1sg-2sg.note: Basa Inggris mung nganggo siji kriya 'be' kanggo kahanan lan sipat: "I am Anna" lan "I am tired" padha-padha nganggo 'am'.
ovl.es.en.gn.be-all.note: Kanggo kahanan sementara lan sipat tetep, basa Inggris tetep nganggo siji tembung 'is': "the shop is open" lan "the shop is small" padha-padha nganggo 'is'.
ovl.es.en.gn.be-allowed-to.note: 'Be allowed to' nggawa teges ijin ing kabeh wektu: "I wasn't allowed to go out" nuduhake ijin ing wektu kepungkur.
ovl.es.en.gn.be-yesno-q.note: Ing pacelathon saben dinane, pitakonan asring mung nganggo owahing swara; nanging basa Inggris kudu mindhah 'be' menyang ngarep: "Are you tired?" Yen ora, ukara kasebut diwaca kaya pernyataan.
ovl.es.en.gn.can-ability.note: Katrampilan sing wis disinaoni lan kamungkinan utawa ijin kaloro-loro dadi 'can' ing basa Inggris: "I can swim" lan "I can go."
ovl.es.en.gn.comp-superl.note: Kanggo adjektiva cekak, tambahake '-er than' (bigger than); kanggo sing dawa, gunakake 'more … than' — rong dalan iki kudu diapalake.
ovl.es.en.gn.cond-first.note: "If it rains, we'll stay in." Tembung 'will' ora dilebokake ing bageyan if — mung ing bageyan asile.
ovl.es.en.gn.cond-second.note: "If I had time, I would travel." If ditambah wujud past, banjur 'would'; 'would' ora mlebu ing bageyan if.
ovl.es.en.gn.cond-zero.note: Pola iki gampang: "if you heat ice, it melts." Kaloro bageyan tetep nganggo present.
ovl.es.en.gn.conn-discourse.note: 'However' lan 'therefore' tansah dituruti koma: "It was late. However, we kept going."
ovl.es.en.gn.could-past-polite.note: 'Could' nyakup kaloro tegesan: kemampuan wektu kepungkur ("I could swim at five") lan panjaluk sing sopan ("could you help?").
ovl.es.en.gn.count-uncount.note: Sawetara kata benda kaya information, furniture, money, bread, lan advice ora nganggo jamak lan ora nganggo 'a': "a piece of advice," dudu "an advice."
ovl.es.en.gn.dem-sg.note: Basa Jawa duwe telung tingkat cedhak-adoh (iki, kuwi, kae), nanging basa Inggris mung duwe loro: 'this' lan 'that'. 'Kuwi' lan 'kae' kaloro-loro biasane dadi 'that'.
ovl.es.en.gn.do-neg.note: Basa Inggris mung nganggo siji tembung negatif: "I don't see anything" — 'don't' ditambah tembung positif, dudu negatif kaping pindho.
ovl.es.en.gn.do-quest.note: Basa Jawa bisa nganggo tembung 'apa' utawa mung owahing swara kanggo pitakonan; basa Inggris kudu nambahake 'do' utawa 'does': "Do you like coffee?"
ovl.es.en.gn.dummy-it.note: Basa Jawa bisa ngomong 'udan' tanpa subjek, nanging basa Inggris kudu nganggo 'it': "IT is raining. IT's late. IT's cold." Tembung 'it' iki ora nuduhake apa-apa, mung ngisi papan subjek.
ovl.es.en.gn.echo-so-neither.note: Kanggo mangsuli setuju, basa Inggris nyoraki kriya pambantu, dudu mung 'me too': "So am I", "Neither can I."
ovl.es.en.gn.few-little.note: 'A little' lan 'a few' tegese isih ana sethithik; yen 'a'-ne dibuwang, 'little' lan 'few' malah nuduhake kurang cukup.
ovl.es.en.gn.for-since.note: 'For' ngukur dawane wektu (for two years), 'since' nyebutake wiwitane (since 2020) — kaloro beda tembung ing basa Inggris.
ovl.es.en.gn.future-cont.note: "I'll be flying" iku ukara saben dinane, dudu basa resmi. Gunakake bebas kanggo nggambarake tumindak ing sawijining wektu ing mangsa ngarep.
ovl.es.en.gn.gerund-after-verbs.note: Sawise 'enjoy' lan 'mind', basa Inggris mbutuhake -ing: "I like cooking."
ovl.es.en.gn.going-to.note: "I'm going to travel" — pola iki gampang diapalake, gunakake kanthi yakin.
ovl.es.en.gn.had-to.note: "Did you have to wait?" nganggo 'did' kanggo pitakonan, dene pernyataane "I had to wait."
ovl.es.en.gn.have-got.note: Sawetara ukara sing ing basa liya nganggo 'duwe' (kaya luwe, ngelak, umur), ing basa Inggris malah nganggo 'be': "I AM hungry", "I AM thirsty", "I AM 20."
ovl.es.en.gn.have-to.note: "You don't have to come" tegese ora ana kewajiban, dudu dilarang. Wacanen minangka kabebasan, dudu larangan.
ovl.es.en.gn.how-much-many.note: Basa Inggris misahake miturut bisa diitung apa ora: 'how much' kanggo sing ora bisa diitung, 'how many' kanggo sing bisa diitung.
ovl.es.en.gn.imperatives.note: Basa Inggris mung nduweni siji wujud prentah kanggo kabeh wong; 'please' nggawa unsur sopan sing ing basa liya digawa dening tataran sopan-santun.
ovl.es.en.gn.in-case-as-long-as.note: "Take it in case it rains; stay as long as you like" — 'in case' nyawisake kamungkinan, 'as long as' nemtokake syarat.
ovl.es.en.gn.indef-pronouns.note: Basa Inggris mung nganggo siji tembung negatif: "I didn't see anybody", dudu "didn't see nobody."
ovl.es.en.gn.indirect-questions.note: Iki sing asring keliru: pitakonan ing njero panjaluk sing sopan ora dibalik: "could you tell me where the station is?", dudu "where is the station?"
ovl.es.en.gn.infinitive-after-verbs.note: "I want to go" — 'to' kudu ana ing basa Inggris, sanajan ing basa liya kriya digandhengake langsung.
ovl.es.en.gn.infinitive-purpose.note: "To learn", dudu "for learning" — 'to + kriya' nuduhake tujuan ing basa Inggris.
ovl.es.en.gn.like-want-noun.note: "I like tea" — sing seneng dadi subjek ing basa Inggris; ora ana 'me' ing ngarep, lan ora ana artikel kanggo bab umum.
ovl.es.en.gn.make-let.note: "They made me wait", dudu "made me to wait" — sawise 'make' lan 'let', ora ana 'to'.
ovl.es.en.gn.might-may.note: "It might rain" — 'might' lan 'may' nuduhake kamungkinan sing durung mesthi, dudu kemampuan.
ovl.es.en.gn.modal-deduction.note: "He must be tired" nuduhake dugaan sing kuwat; kanggo dugaan negatif, basa Inggris nganggo 'can't be', dudu 'mustn't be.'
ovl.es.en.gn.much-many-alot.note: Basa Inggris misahake dadi 'much' (ora bisa diitung) lan 'many' (bisa diitung); 'a lot of' bisa kanggo kaloro-loro ing ukara positif.
ovl.es.en.gn.must-mustnt.note: 'Mustn't' nuduhake larangan, beda karo 'don't have to' sing tegese ora ana kewajiban — aja dicampur.
ovl.es.en.gn.narrative-tenses.note: Kedadeyan mlebu ing past simple, latar mburine mlebu ing past continuous — pisahan iki penting kanggo nyritakake crita kanthi runtut.
ovl.es.en.gn.obj-pron.note: Ing basa Inggris, pronomina objek manggon sawise kriya: "I'll call you. I see her. Ask him."
ovl.es.en.gn.passive-past.note: "Was built in 1900" — pola iki gampang dienggo, langsung padha karo tegesane.
ovl.es.en.gn.passive-present.note: "Spanish is spoken" — basa Inggris nganggo 'be' ditambah past participle kanggo ukara pasif.
ovl.es.en.gn.past-be.note: Basa Inggris mung nduweni siji wujud past kanggo 'be': 'was' lan 'were' — luwih gampang tinimbang basa liya sing mbedakake.
ovl.es.en.gn.past-cont.note: "I was eating" — 'was/were' ditambah -ing, gampang dienggo: dienggo pola iki wae.
ovl.es.en.gn.past-perfect.note: "Had eaten" — 'had' ditambah past participle, pola iki gampang lan langsung.
ovl.es.en.gn.past-reg.note: Akhiran -ed nduweni telung swara: /t/ (worked), /d/ (played), /ɪd/ (visited). Ucapake 'visited' nganggo telung wanda, 'worked' nganggo siji wae.
ovl.es.en.gn.past-simple-vs-cont.note: Tumindak sing kesela nganggo 'was -ing': "I was cooking when he arrived."
ovl.es.en.gn.perf-cont-vs-simple.note: Basa Inggris mbedakake asil lan kegiyatan: "I've painted it" dibandhingake "I've been painting."
ovl.es.en.gn.phrasal-separable.note: Ora ana pola sing padha ing basa liya, mula apalna: "turn it on", dudu "turn on it", pronomina ing tengah.
ovl.es.en.gn.plural-irreg.note: "People" jamak ing basa Inggris: "people are friendly", dudu "people is."
ovl.es.en.gn.poss-adj.note: Basa Inggris misahake miturut sing duwe: his, her, its, lan their kabeh beda tembung — cocogna karo sing duwe, dudu barang sing diduweni.
ovl.es.en.gn.poss-s.note: Basa Inggris ora nduweni 'de'; "Ana's dog" mbalik urutane — sing duwe dhisik, barange kapindho.
ovl.es.en.gn.prep-place.note: Basa Inggris misahake dadi 'in', 'on', lan 'at' gumantung panggonane; "on the table" kanggo barang ing sadhuwure meja.
ovl.es.en.gn.pres-cont-future.note: "I'm meeting Ana at six" — present continuous ditambah wektu nuduhake rencana.
ovl.es.en.gn.pres-cont.note: "I am eating" — 'be' ditambah kriya-ing, apalna pola iki.
ovl.es.en.gn.pres-perf-been-gone.note: 'Gone' tegese isih ana ing kono, 'been' tegese wis lunga lan bali: "has gone to Lima" dibandhingake "has been to Lima."
ovl.es.en.gn.pres-perf-cont.note: "I have been living here for two years" — basa Inggris nganggo 'have been -ing' kanggo nyebutake dawane wektu.
ovl.es.en.gn.pres-perf-exp.note: "I have eaten at two" iku salah; yen wektune wis disebutake, gunakake past simple, dudu present perfect.
ovl.es.en.gn.pres-perf-vs-past.note: Iki sing paling asring keliru: yen wektune wis rampung — sanajan "today at two" — basa Inggris kudu nganggo past simple, dudu present perfect.
ovl.es.en.gn.pres-perf-yet-already.note: 'Already' kanggo ukara positif, 'yet' kanggo pitakonan lan negatif: "I have just eaten."
ovl.es.en.gn.pres-simple-3sg.note: Iki keluputan sing paling asring: "she work" kudu ditambahi -s — "she works."
ovl.es.en.gn.pres-simple-base.note: Basa Inggris ninggalake kriyane dhasar lan gumantung marang pronomina: "I speak, you speak."
ovl.es.en.gn.pron-subject.note: Basa Inggris tansah mbutuhake pronomina subjek: ucapake "I am Ana", dudu mung "am Ana."
ovl.es.en.gn.question-tags.note: Question tag ing basa Inggris nyontoni kriya pambantune lan mbalik tandane — iki kudu dilatih kanthi tliti.
ovl.es.en.gn.rel-object-omit.note: Basa Inggris bisa ngilangi tembung relatif objek kanthi bebas: "the film we watched" ora perlu 'that.'
ovl.es.en.gn.rel-where-whose.note: 'Whose' tetep dibutuhake ing basa Inggris: "the writer whose book won."
ovl.es.en.gn.reported-commands.note: "She told me to wait" — panjaluk dadi 'tell' utawa 'ask' ditambah to-infinitive.
ovl.es.en.gn.reported-questions.note: Kaluputan sing kerep: "she asked where I lived", dudu "asked where did I live."
ovl.es.en.gn.reported-statements.note: Wektune mundur siji tingkat kaya biasane; jebakane ana ing urutan tembung, sing tetep kaya pernyataan biasa ing basa Inggris.
ovl.es.en.gn.say-vs-tell.note: 'Tell' mbutuhake wong (tell me), 'say' ora. Lan ukarane "explain to me", dudu "explain me."
ovl.es.en.gn.should-advice.note: "You should rest" — 'should' ditambah kriya dhasar, tanpa 'to.'
ovl.es.en.gn.simple-vs-cont.note: "I eat" nuduhake pakulinan, "I am eating" nuduhake saiki — pilihen miturut tembung wektune.
ovl.es.en.gn.so-because-although.note: Titenana: 'because' ora padha karo 'because of', lan basa Inggris ora numpuk 'although…but' — pilih siji wae.
ovl.es.en.gn.some-any.note: Basa Inggris nganggo 'some' ing ukara positif lan 'any' ing pitakonan/negatif: "Do you have any money?"
ovl.es.en.gn.superl-perf-ever.note: Basa Inggris nambahake tembung 'ever': "the best I have ever seen."
ovl.es.en.gn.sv-order.note: Basa Inggris tetep nganggo urutan Subjek–Kriya–Objek, ora kaya basa liya sing luwih bebas — tetepake sing nglakoni ing ngarep, sanajan krasa mbulet.
ovl.es.en.gn.there-is-are.note: Basa Inggris nyocogake wilangan: there IS a cafe, there ARE two cafes.
ovl.es.en.gn.time-clauses.note: Basa Inggris nganggo present kanggo tegesan mangsa ngarep sawise 'when': "when I arrive", dudu "when I will arrive."
ovl.es.en.gn.time-prep.note: Basa Inggris misahake dadi telu: at five, on Monday, in May — apalna kaya siji paket.
ovl.es.en.gn.time-telling.note: "It's three o'clock" — basa Inggris nganggo 'it's' tunggal kanggo saben jam, ditambah 'o'clock' ing jam sing pas.
ovl.es.en.gn.too-enough.note: 'Enough' manggon sawise adjektiva nanging sadurunge kata benda: "warm enough, enough time."
ovl.es.en.gn.too-to-so-that.note: "Too tired to drive" lan "so tired that I slept" — kaloro nggawe asil saka rasa sing dirasakake.
ovl.es.en.gn.unless.note: Basa Inggris nganggo present biasa sawise 'unless': "unless we leave."
ovl.es.en.gn.used-to-vs-would.note: Gunakake 'used to' kanggo kahanan kepungkur, lan 'would' mung kanggo tumindak sing bola-bali.
ovl.es.en.gn.used-to.note: "I used to run" — used to run, dudu used to ran; kriyane tetep wujud dhasar.
ovl.es.en.gn.verb-obj-inf.note: "I want you to come" — objek ditambah infinitive sawise kriya kaya 'want.'
ovl.es.en.gn.verb-patterns-contrast.note: "Stop smoking" lan "remember to do" — pola sing dienggo nemtokake tegese.
ovl.es.en.gn.wh-quest-be.note: "Where are you from?" — tembung cilik 'from' pindhah menyang mburi ing pitakonan saben dinane.
ovl.es.en.gn.will-decide-offer.note: "I'll help you" — basa Inggris nganggo 'will' nalika mutusake sanalika.
ovl.es.en.gn.will-predict.note: 'Will' ora owah wujude kanggo subjek apa wae: "will rain" kanggo kabeh wong.
ovl.es.en.gn.will-vs-going-to.note: 'Going to' kanggo rencana sing wis dipikir, 'will' kanggo keputusan sing dumadakan.
ovl.es.en.gn.wish-past.note: "I wish I had a garden" — wujud past sawise 'wish' nuduhake yen kuwi ora nyata.
ovl.es.en.gn.would-like-offers.note: "Would you like a coffee?" luwih sopan tinimbang langsung takon karepe; "I'd like..." kanggo njaluk kanthi alus.
ovl.es.en.gn.would-like.note: "I'd like..." — cara sopan kanggo njaluk ing kafe, toko, lan hotel.
